target_moa.text: Benralizumab is a humanized monoclonal antibody (IgG1/kappa) selective for the interleukin-5 receptor alpha subunit (IL-5Rα), expressed on eosinophils and basophils; its afucosylated Fc domain binds FcγRIII on NK cells to induce apoptosis of eosinophils and basophils via antibody-dependent cell-mediated cytotoxicity (ADCC).

citations.quote: Benralizumab is a humanized monoclonal antibody (IgG1/\kappa-class) selective for interleukin-5 receptor alpha subunit (IL-5R\alpha).

The IL-5 receptor is expressed on the surface of eosinophils and basophils. In an in vitro setting the absence of fucose in the Fc domain of benralizumab facilitates binding to Fc\gammaRIII receptors on immune effectors cells, such as natural killer (NK) cells, leading to apoptosis of eosinophils and basophils through antibody-dependent cell-mediated cytotoxicity (ADCC).
